thread:
people-ops: Org update  Priya Natarajan is promoted to Head of Runtime (effective 2026-05-18). She'll lead Runtime-Core and Runtime-Inference as a split org: Runtime-Core (platform plumbing, schedulers) and Runtime-Inference (model-serving optimizations). This is a lateral promotion to consolidate runtime ownership and speed up model-onboarding flow.

Priya Natarajan: Really excited  thanks for the trust. Immediate plan: 1) finalize team split org chart this week, 2) name interim managers for both squads, 3) kick off hiring for two Staff Eng IC leads and one Eng Manager (Runtime-Inference).

Diego Morales: Congrats Priya! We'll align on cross-team SLAs and roadmap priorities. I'll support the customer-facing communications and ensure product commitments are covered during the transition.

Aisha Patel: Hiring note: we'll run internal-first referrals for 4 business days. Roles: Staff Eng (Runtime-Core), Staff Eng (Runtime-Inference), Eng Manager (Runtime-Inference). HC codes: ENG-RUN-101, ENG-RUN-102 (backfills), ENG-RUN-201 (new). I'll post owners + JD drafts by EOD.

Evan Carter: Need clarity: are these net-new headcount or reorg'd? We should flag any budget impacts for Q3.

people-ops: Evan  two Staff roles are backfills (reallocated within runtime budget), Eng Manager is newly approved for Q2 hire. HC codes above reflect that.

Lina Chavez: For on-call and pager rotation changes, Priya  can we get a freeze window for any topology changes until we finish the split? We should avoid rolling changes during the handoff.

Priya Natarajan: Yes Lina  propose a freeze: no infra topology changes 2026-05-18 to 2026-06-01 except critical fixes. I'll publish the rotation plan and interim on-call owners by 2026-05-15.

HiringBot: Reminder: create Greenhouse jobs under "runtime" tag and set internal-referral window to 4 business days. Deadline to create rubrics: 2026-04-12.

Aisha Patel: Interview plan: 1) quick internal screen, 2) technical deep-dive (systems + perf), 3) management/leadership panel for manager role. Panelists: runtime lead, infra rep, product partner, people-ops.

Diego Morales: I'll draft a short announcement for external stakeholders and account teams. Priya  please add any customer-impact notes to the doc.

Priya Natarajan: Will do. Also setting up 30-min "all-hands runtime" on Mon to walk through the org map and hiring plan. Invite to follow.

people-ops: Action items: Aisha to post reqs + owners; Priya to publish rotation plan + org chart; HiringBot to follow up on rubrics; Diego to draft customer note. Congrats Priya! :tada:
